name: mode
meaning: SetMode stores arg 1 (0x43eb70); Update/HandleMessage test it (movzx byte)

name: watchState
meaning: SetMode stores arg 2 (0x43eb84); Update switches on it (0..4) driving the Watch

name: savedWolfPos
meaning: SetMode mode 1 copies g_pWolf's +0xc/+0xe/+0x10 here at 0x43ecf2-0x43ed27, and Update restores the Wolf from it at 0x43ef83 `add edx,0x80`. This is the position the 'pWolfRestore' story actually needed

name: wolfMoved
meaning: Reset writes the literal 1 at 0x43e8bd and 0 at 0x43e8cc, Update only tests it against 0 (0x43ef74) and clears it (0x43efad); it is never dereferenced. Boolean 'Daffy has moved the Wolf, put him back'

name: confirmBox
meaning: Update fills text 0x8c, rect 0x98..0x9e, bgColor 0xa0 and passes &this->+0x8c to Ui_DrawTextBox; reads confirmChoice 0x90 (byte) and fits 0x94

name: currentText
meaning: written 0x43d710 (g_trainingEmptyText at 0x43d699), read 0x43d732

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: set 1 when the Wolf accepts msg 0xe, cleared after msg 0xf (SetMode 0x43ec6a)

name: confirmTag
meaning: DtlConfirmTag: set 1 / cleared 0x43d85b / 0x43d867; 2 while Update shows the yes/no box

name: cameraNotify
meaning: Reset sets 1 (byte); Update sends msg to helpCamera and clears

name: initNotify
meaning: PostLoadInit sets 1/0 (byte); Update notifies helpCamera once

name: retryPhase
meaning: Reset increments and clamps to 1; SetMode mode 2 zeroes

name: replayingHelp
meaning: set 1 by HandleMessage's MSG_USE arm, cleared by Reset, zeroed by PostLoadInit and by SetMode mode 2

name: lineFlags
meaning: PostLoadInit clears bit 1, Reset sets it (|=2), Update tests bit 1 at 0x43f046 and clears it at 0x43f09b; Reset also tests bit 0

name: fromPreviousMask
meaning: FROMPREVIOUS property (prop +0x5c = record+0x70; 0x43e30d); Reset tests bit helpIndex

name: helpCount
meaning: counts the slots whose TRAJECTORY_n resolved, not whose BOX_n resolved - the gate at 0x43e3e0 tests [ebp-8], filled at 0x43e3d9 from Scn_FindIdList on table+4 (=TRAJECTORY). A slot with an unresolved BOX still counts and stores 0 at +0x1c8

name: helpIndex
meaning: current help point; compared unsigned (jbe/ja) in SetMode

name: trajNodeIndex
meaning: index into the current help point's trajectory node list — Reset's walk target is *(this+0x12c+idx*8) + 2 + *(int*)(this+0xcc)*6. Zeroed by PostLoadInit and Reset

name: savedHelpIndex
meaning: Update watch state 1 copies helpIndex

name: challengeDuration
meaning: PostLoadInit: record+0x98 * 100

name: helpTextIds
meaning: indexed dword store 0x43e352; low-byte fetch 0x43d6b8

name: helpSlot
meaning: +0x128+i*8 is TYPE_n (0x43e38a from table+6) and +0x12c+i*8 is the resolved TRAJECTORY_n id list (0x43e42a from table+4), not the BOX. Reset walks it 6 bytes per node

name: helpBox
meaning: the resolved BOX_n id-list entry (0x43e35f loads table+2 = BOX; 0x43e412 stores it to this+4*helpCount+0x1c8), 0 when the property did not resolve; not the trajectory

name: startBox
meaning: Scn_GetPropBox(record,0x7c)

name: finishBox
meaning: Scn_GetPropBox(record,0x80)

name: cameras
meaning: CAMERAS property: Scn_GetPropObject(record,0x50) at 0x43e4b0; msg 0xd00 target

name: cinematics
meaning: CINEMATICS property: Scn_GetPropObject(record,0x54) at 0x43e50e; msg 0x1400 target

name: cameraFlags
meaning: PostLoadInit zeroes two bytes

name: animPhase
meaning: Reset/SetMode zero (word); Update idle anim step

name: initFlag
meaning: DtlJumpPhase: the phase of a hop, read and stepped by MoveTo; set to 1 by PostLoadInit (0x43e297), SetMode's mode-0 arm (0x43ebf7), a finished move and each new help point

name: movementDone
meaning: MoveTo sets 1/0

name: lastSpeechMs
meaning: SetMode mode 1 stamps it with g_gameTimeMs at 0x43ed8f; Update's idle fallback tests g_gameTimeMs - this >= 0x5dc at 0x43f787

name: currentTime
meaning: MoveTo: g_gameTime*1000>>12

name: lastTargetTime
meaning: MoveTo

name: jumpDuration
meaning: MoveTo: 400 or Anim_GetDurationMs

name: gait
meaning: MoveTo gait of the current target

name: moveStart
meaning: MoveTo copies pos

name: target
meaning: MoveTo target x/z words

name: deathDelay
meaning: Update watch state 3 countdown

name: useLatched
meaning: set 1 by HandleMessage's MSG_USE arm alongside the Wolf freeze; zeroed by PostLoadInit

name: stopTag
meaning: set 1 / cleared 0x43d834 / 0x43d840

name: viewTag
meaning: stored 0x43d81a

name: viewStart
meaning: g_gameTime stamp

name: lockTag
meaning: stored 0x43d804

name: dialogueRestart
meaning: Update/Reset

name: robotSequence
meaning: SetMode/Update

name: forcedFreeze
meaning: SetMode/Update

name: robot
meaning: Update: class 0xa5 found in the help box

name: watch
meaning: Scenaric_FindByClass(0x67,&this->watch,1)

name: pendingVoice
meaning: stored 0x43d71c, tested 0x43d63c

name: jokeVoice1
meaning: record+0x88

name: jokeVoice2
meaning: record+0x8c

name: helpVoice
meaning: HELPVOICE property (prop +0x6c, 0x43e720); written by PostLoadInit, not read by the class code

name: jokeEnabled
meaning: PROPERTY JOKEENABLED (prop +0x70); used as a BITMASK, Reset tests 1 << helpIndex — not a plain boolean. Last dword of the 0x290 object
